page_title: AI app builder for internal business apps | Glide

sources.entry: Glide - no-code platform that allows users to create AI-powered applications quickly and easily using their business data, with customer support chatbots. #freemium

summary.name: Glide
summary.one_liner: Glide is a business operations platform that turns Excel and Google Sheets into internal business apps and AI agents.
use_cases: Turning a Google Sheets or Excel workbook into a mobile-friendly app
Building internal business apps with AI from a prompt
Logging data from the field on a phone while back office stays synced
Asking an AI agent questions about live business data
Installing and customizing pre-built app templates
Creating customer support chatbots on business data
summary.what_it_does: Glide reads spreadsheets (including formulas, lookups and notes) through a feature called SheetSense and uses an AI agent to build a working app for desktop and phone from them. Users can click any number to see how it was calculated, in plain English. Apps can be shared with a team and stay private to the company by default, and changes made on a phone in the field sync to the back office. An AI agent can answer questions about the business from live data. The page also describes Glide Enterprise controls such as single sign-on, role-based row access, AI spend budgets, approved models and an audit log, plus a marketplace of app templates.
notable: Turns Excel and Google Sheets into apps and AI agents with no code
SheetSense reads formulas, lookups and notes in a spreadsheet
Click-through explanations of how any number was calculated
Enterprise governance: SSO, row-level roles, audit log, AES-256 encryption
caveats: Enterprise governance features are described under Glide Enterprise, which suggests they are a higher tier; exact pricing is not stated on the page
Page lists 'desktop and phone' but does not name specific mobile operating systems beyond the general field use
